leadStory: Bradley Barcola has agreed personal terms with Liverpool on a contract to 2032, and the club have tabled a record-class opening bid worth around £103m as PSG hold near €180m; on the grass Iraola's World Cup men finally play in Sunday's Leeds finale in Chicago.
